Cinderella flees the palace ball; a moonlit ballroom backcloth glows under footlights, painted arch flats receding in three layers toward a tiny chandelier of knotted thread.
A fairy-tale forest at midnight, layered painted tree flats darkening toward centre, a thatched cottage cut-out lit by a single warm bulb sunk into the stage floor.
Rumpelstiltskin spins gold in a miller's daughter's cell; painted stone-wall flats overlap in recession, a paper spinning wheel stands centre, straw of teased cotton wool scattered on the boards.
A storm at sea tears at the rigging of a galleon cut-out; painted wave-boards rock in their grooves, the backcloth a bruised purple wash, rain of silver thread falling from the flies.
Jack presents the golden harp before an angry throne; painted arch flats frame a paper throne on a velvet-covered riser, a tiny carpet of red felt leads the eye upstage.
The princess lowers her hair from a moonlit tower; a cut-out turret stands before a painted night sky, a tissue paper moon hung on a wire catches the warm footlight glow.
A medieval village carnival fills the square; painted shopfront flats on both sides, paper bunting strung diagonally overhead, a painted cobblestone cloth covering the stage boards.
Saint George confronts the dragon in its cave; jagged painted rock flats overlap in three planes, a treasure heap of crinkled foil and glass beads glitters under a single amber bulb.
A winter's tale unfolds on a snowy street; white-flocked flats frame a paper lamppost at centre, torn tissue snowflakes drifting down from the flies on invisible threads.
Beauty walks through an enchanted garden; painted trellis flats rise at the back, cardboard topiary hedges stand in tiered rows, paper roses pinned at intervals across each level.
A circus ringmaster opens the great show; a striped painted backcloth arches overhead, a painted sawdust ring marked on the boards, a paper hoop on a wire stand at centre stage.
The little mermaid swims toward a sunken palace; blue gauze layers hang at three depths, cut-out fish on wires drift at varying heights, a painted coral backcloth glows amber from behind.
A kitchen witch brews a forbidden soup; a painted dresser flat fills the back wall, tiny clay pots crowd a low shelf, a paper fireplace cut-out stands left with orange tissue flames.
John Barleycorn is cut down at harvest; painted corn-stook flats flank the stage in overlapping rows, a low golden backcloth saturates the scene, a paper scythe leans against the nearest flat.
Merlin deciphers a prophecy in his study; a painted bookshelf flat curves at the rear, a cut-out arched window shows a star-pricked paper sky behind, candle-stub footlights warm the boards.

A market fair in full swing at midday; painted stall-front flats in two overlapping rows, paper lanterns strung overhead on cotton thread, a printed playbill pinned to one stall, lettering worn to abstraction.
The three billy goats cross a painted wooden bridge; a bridge flat arches across the full stage, painted rushes rise in the wings, a rippled blue backcloth suggests the river below.
Lawrence of the desert faces the endless sands; painted dune flats overlap in four receding layers of ochre and rose, a large paper sun sits low behind the rearmost flat.
A clockwork toymaker locks up his shop for the night; painted shelves bear tinier painted toys in rows, a counter flat sits mid-stage, warm light from a single practical bulb overhead.
The Snow Queen holds court in her frozen palace; silver-painted flats frame a cellophane icicle curtain, prismatic light from a hidden bulb scatters across the backcloth, a paper throne at centre.
Farmer Giles discovers a fox in the henhouse; a painted red barn flat anchors the rear, a zigzag fence runs across the boards in front, a paper moon tacked to the backcloth.
Aladdin wishes on the lamp beneath a desert night; a dark painted backcloth is pricked with pinholes, a small bulb behind throws pinpoint stars through, the lamp a foil-wrapped prop centre stage.

Pinocchio runs away to the puppet theatre; a toy-theatre-within-a-toy-theatre painted flat fills the rear, tiny painted audience rows visible, warm footlight amber spilling from the miniature proscenium.

The selfish giant sleeps while spring returns to his garden; painted blossom-tree flats in two receding layers, a cardboard garden-wall cut-out at the front, torn white tissue blossom drifts from the flies.
The tin soldier stands his last watch on a riverbank; a painted stone bridge flat spans the rear, paper rushes flutter in the wings, a low amber footlight strip warms the painted water cloth.
